intro: Imprisoned without explanation, you must escape Velendar Castle and uncover the truth behind the king’s wrath.
description:
The king has taken you prisoner.

Your home was reduced to ashes, and your mother, your only family, was executed under his command. You committed no crime… So why are you here? What does the king truly want from you?

Trapped within the majestic yet ominous halls of Velendar Castle, you must explore its secrets, uncover hidden truths, and find a way to escape before it’s too late.

Advance through the grand chambers of Velendar Castle, each filled with mystery, beauty, and danger. Every room tells a story, if you know how to read it.

Observe your surroundings carefully and use logic to overcome intricate puzzles. Clues are hidden in plain sight, mechanisms conceal deeper meanings, and every solved challenge brings you closer to freedom.

Was your imprisonment truly without reason… or is there a darker truth waiting to be revealed?
